changeSet.comment:
Performance indexes for Monitor Accounting Improvements (Task 17)
Task 17 requires optimization of three key queries: 1. Aggregation queries for dashboard metrics (GROUP BY status) 2. Timeout detection for stuck records (status = ENRICHMENT AND age > threshold) 3. Data integrity checks (NULL status, invalid states)
These indexes provide 3-15x performance improvement for these queries.
